title: Cycling Shorts Men's – Padded with Compression
descriptionHtml:
Mile after mile is great. The saddle isn't.

It's never your legs that decide how long the ride is – it's how long you can stand to sit.

The solution: padding where it counts

Cycling shorts with shock-absorbing seat padding and a compression fit that supports the muscles without squeezing. Elastic waist, nothing that chafes – just more miles in the saddle.

Features

  • More miles in the saddle – shock-absorbing padding
  • Supports without squeezing – compression fit
  • Doesn't chafe – elastic waist
  • Not see-through – nothing to worry about on the uphill
  • For MTB, road cycling and spinning

Change your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
